visual_concept: A ring with a hidden tasbih: deep-emerald ground, two circular macro insets (thumb tap / count display), labelled

hooks.text: A ring with a hidden tasbih
It passes as a regular ring.
Loud clicker out. Quiet ring on.
Quiet office? Count your dhikr anyway.
What if your tasbih looked like jewelry?

headline: A tasbih hidden on your finger
primary_text:
It looks like a ring. Under the table, it counts your dhikr.

Tap the gold button to count. The small display shows your total.

At 33, 66 and 99, you feel a gentle vibration. You know where you are without looking down.

No loud clicker. No beads to drop. No phone to open.

"Let not your tongue cease to be moist with the remembrance of Allah." (Tirmidhi 3375)

Free US shipping and a 60-day money-back guarantee. Tap Shop Now.

cta.offer: free US shipping and 60-day money-back guarantee (brief.md / intake.md)

Scene: A vertical social-media ad built on a dark, softly blurred macro photo of a hand wearing exactly one black smart ring, filling the whole frame as an out-of-focus background in deep emerald green. Over it sit two large overlapping circular photo insets, each with a thin white ring border, side by side in the centre of the frame, overlapping slightly in the middle. Left circle: a macro of a right thumb pressing the small gold Al Rayan logo button on the black ring, worn on a finger of a relaxed hand. Right circle: a macro of the black ring's display, ONE single horizontal row of four white seven-segment digits reading 5-3-3-2 on a black screen, the gold Al Rayan logo button beside it. Above the circles is a big headline; below them two short captions, one pill button and a thin two-line bar.

Style: Polished modern product-macro photography combined with clean flat graphic overlay, like a high-performing direct-response static ad. Crisp, calm, premium but approachable. Not an illustration, no CGI gloss.

Lighting: Soft, directional key light from upper left on the circle photos, gentle highlight along the black metal band and the screen, deep emerald ambient shadow in the background, slight vignette toward the edges.

Camera: Background: macro, shallow depth of field, heavily blurred. Insets: macro close-ups, eye-level to slightly above, ring in sharp focus, 85mm product-lens feel.

Composition & layout: Vertical 9:16 frame. Headline band 14% to 25% of frame height, centred, 88% of frame width, on two lines. Two overlapping circles from 27% to 49.5% of frame height, each circle about 44% of frame width in diameter (centres at 29% and 71% of width, overlapping by about 2% of width in the middle), thin white 3 px ring border. Left caption block (title then why-line) from 51% to 59.5% of height, centred under the left circle, width 6% to 48%. Right caption block in the same band, centred under the right circle, width 52% to 94%. Left caption block belongs to the thumb-tap circle, right caption block to the display circle. Cream pill button 61.5% to 65.5% of height, centred, 44% of frame width. Thin full-width cream bar from 66.5% to 74% of height holding two centred lines of text. Below 75% the frame is only the dark blurred background, no text, no objects. Top 0 to 13% only blurred background. Focal flow: headline, left circle, right circle, captions, pill, bar.

Brand colors: Background deep emerald #0F3D26 fading to #0A2A1A at the edges; brand green #1F5A2E as a soft glow behind the circles; all headline and caption text white #FFFFFF; button cream #F3F7F0 with near-black #111111 text; bottom bar cream #EAF2E6 with #1A1A1A text; the gold only on the ring's own logo button. The ring is black.

Product: Match the attached product reference image exactly: shape, label, colors, logo. Do not redesign, re-letter, simplify or recolor the label. Do not invent label text. The product is a black metal smart ring, not a bottle. The display is ONE single horizontal row of four white seven-segment digits reading 5-3-3-2 on a black screen, the gold Al Rayan logo button beside it, exactly as in the product PNG; never digits running along the band. Exactly one ring in each circle (the same ring), the display and the gold logo button both visible and facing the camera in the display circle, the gold logo button under the thumb in the thumb-tap circle. Ring fills about 60% of each circle. A natural adult hand, five fingers, relaxed, thumb not covering the display.

Text: Render exactly seven text elements, nothing else:
1) "A ring with a hidden tasbih" — clean geometric sans-serif, bold, sentence case, white #FFFFFF, centred in the headline band on two lines: line 1 "A ring with", line 2 "a hidden tasbih", cap height about 4.6% of frame height, very legible at thumbnail size.
2) "Silent Count" — under the left circle, clean geometric sans-serif, semibold, Title Case, white #FFFFFF, centred, cap height about 2.6% of frame height.
3) "Tap it in meetings." — directly below text 2, clean geometric sans-serif, regular, sentence case, white #FFFFFF, centred, one or two lines, cap height about 2.5% of frame height.
4) "Gentle Pulse" — under the right circle, same style as text 2.
5) "Feel 33, 66, 99." — below text 4, same style as text 3.
6) "Shop Now" — inside the cream pill, clean geometric sans-serif, bold, Title Case exactly as written, near-black #111111, centred, cap height about 2.5% of frame height.
7) "Free US shipping 60-day money-back" — inside the thin cream bar, typewriter monospace, regular, #1A1A1A, centred, exactly as written (not all caps), on two lines: line 1 "Free US shipping", line 2 "60-day money-back", cap height about 2.5% of frame height.

Legibility: Spell every word exactly as written, letter for letter, with the exact capitalisation and punctuation. The word "tasbih" is spelled T-A-S-B-I-H. High contrast on every element, fully inside the frame with at least 6% side margins, no letters cut off or touching the circles.
